hypothesis: Matching LingBot's initial zero action-history frame raises paired no-leak action improvement beyond E30's 0.900% without losing its video gain.
single_variable: Prepend one four-step raw zero action frame before quantile normalization, condition it as observed history during causal sampling, and omit it from execution. Keep E30 architecture, data, objective, optimizer and 100-step budget fixed.
parent_baseline: E30 official-LR s100: raw val40 video/action improvements 18.112%/3.067%, causal sample40 improvements 14.020%/0.900%, task3 0/1 with no contact.

references.title: Causal World Modeling for Robot Control

data.upstream_code: dataset prepends frame_stride*4 zeros before normalization as the first frame of a streaming sequence
data.local: prepend four raw zero actions to every cold-start window
data.rationale: The local window has no persistent frame index or KV lifecycle.

action.upstream_code: server fixes the action frame only at frame_st_id==0, client skips it only on the first call, then updates persistent KV
action.local: every replan cold-starts, fixes four actions and removes them
action.rationale: Matching a prefix tensor is not equivalent to LingBot's streaming state machine.

evaluation.local: raw val40, paired sample40, then fixed task3 trial0
evaluation.rationale: Staged gate minimizes low-value GPU use.

decision.rationale: Retrospective source audit found that the local cold-start anchor is not equivalent to LingBot's first-frame-only anchor plus persistent KV lifecycle. The trainer now rejects this flag and the server rejects the legacy stage; do not run rollout, resume or scale it.
decision.launch_command: BLOCKED: the legacy anchor command is intentionally rejected until persistent LingBot frame/KV state is implemented
